frequency_question: What proportion of proposed major fee rulemakings reach final publication within approximately one year of significant public contestation?
membership_rule: Includes all federal agency proposed rules published in the Federal Register involving major fee adjustments exceeding 1000% increases that underwent public comment and faced legal or intense political challenges; excludes routine adjustments tied to inflation.

coverage_note: 10 named cases representing major contested regulatory actions; believed roughly 15-20 in total across recent administrations.
known_gaps: Excludes minor agency adjustments and rules whose litigation timelines stretched beyond multi-year horizons without initial finalization markers.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and judicial review standards remain stable over medium-term horizons.
